Container.Name: orson-butterflies
Container.Overview:
Orson and the Butterflies - a 3D dog-park game in the browser. Run Orson, a giant schnauzer, around a dusk-lit park catching butterflies before the gates close. Timed, hard and free-play modes, with tug ropes, a stick, kickable balls, rival dogs and a rabbit called Jeremiah. Plays on a keyboard or a touch screen.
Stateless: no volumes, no database, nothing written to the array. Best scores live in each visitor's browser.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port to reach the game on. Change this if 8080 is already taken.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Port nginx listens on inside the container. Leave alone unless you know why.
